People: George Manville Fenn (author, Wikidata Q644784), died 1909; Henri Théophile Hildibrand (illustrator, Wikidata Q3132072), died 1897; Edouard Riou (illustrator, Wikidata Q583275), died 1900. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Fenn, George Manville, 1831-1909; Hildibrand, Henri Théophile, 1824-1897 [Illustrator]; Riou, Edouard, 1833-1900 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The silver cañon : a tale of the western plains, London : Sampson Low, Marston, and co., 1891, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/silvercanontaleo00fenn. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 87%, 94% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Henri Théophile Hildibrand, Edouard Riou, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
